fields.Name: Skip ICF - Upcoming Committee Meetings
fields.Description: Table of scheduled committee meetings (Committees: Meetings with Status=Scheduled). Ported from "Upcoming Events List" — ICF has only two event products, so scheduled governance meetings are the dated upcoming-calendar data.

InputDefinition.userMessage: Give me a table of all committee meetings that are still scheduled (not yet held), with the committee name, meeting name, date and time, and whether it is virtual or in person. I want to be able to click on a meeting to open it. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a table of committee meetings
Only meetings with a Scheduled status are shown (12 meetings, from October 2026 to January 2027), not completed ones
Table includes committee name, meeting name, date/time and location type (Virtual or InPerson)
All six committees appear (Events, Awards & Competition, Food Safety, Standards, Membership & Outreach, Education)
Rows can open the underlying meeting record
